messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished, playable 2D Civilization-style browser game on a tiny 10×10 map limited to 20 turns, from the user request: "2D Civilization on a tiny 10×10 map, 20 turns".

## Requirements
- 2D civilization game.
- 10×10 map.
- Exactly 20 turns.
- Should be playable in a browser and visually polished.
- Mobile/tablet responsiveness is expected by repository guidance.

## Decisions
- Built a static HTML/CSS/JS game with no build system or external dependencies.
- Theme: “Pocket Empire — Tiny World · Twenty Turns,” dark cartographic war-room aesthetic with parchment/gold/jade accents.
- Gameplay: player faction “Sunfall Reach” versus AI “Cinder Court”; city production, growth, territory claiming, workers/improvements, research, ruins/villages, combat, city capture, and end-of-game Legacy scoring.
- Map is handcrafted, 10×10, with two capitals, terrain types, ruins, and villages.
- Research/tech, production, combat, AI movement/attacks, and scoring are implemented.
- AI aggression was tuned to hold near Cinderhold until turn 6 or until the player approaches within 3 tiles.
- Combat clamp bug fixed: `clamp(value, min, max)` argument order was corrected for unit and city damage.
- Several test scripts were used with Playwright and system Chrome at `/opt/google/chrome/chrome` because the installed Playwright browser version mismatched.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and JS modules under `js/`.
- Implemented 10×10 map, 20-turn loop, cities, units, settlers, workers, improvements, research, combat, AI, score, toasts, tooltips, help/research modals, sound, and end screen.
- Ran automated tests confirming no page/console errors.
- Verified desert/plains/forest/hills/mountains/water rendering and basic interactions.
- Verified worker farm building, warrior movement, turn cycling, AI production, and combat.
- Confirmed game can end by defeat, conquest, or time.
- A defensive playthrough reached turn 20 and ended by time score, with player capital surviving.

### Active
- Visual/UX polish and balancing are still in progress.
- Current known visual issues:
  - Left panel has significant empty space below the Chronicle card; add a legacy stat grid and/or flex-fill chronicle.
  - Right panel has empty space below the context card; add a persistent “field notes” or advisor card.
  - Unit tokens on city tiles overlap city sprites awkwardly; add a garrison/stacked offset style.
  - Unit icons (warrior/scout) do not read clearly at small size; redesign with bolder filled silhouettes.
  - Toast overlaps bottom hint; reposition toast layer.
  - Chronicle text can appear ghosted/faded during capture if screenshot occurs before log animation settles; screenshot verification should wait ~800ms.
  - City name plates are tiny and risk clipping.
  - Map could use stronger tile contrast/grid separation and more city-center emphasis.
- A passive player still loses around turn 18; active defense can reach turn 20. Need final balancing/strategy feel.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Apply CSS/UX fixes for left/right panel fill, unit-on-city stacking, clearer unit icons, and toast placement.
2. Verify at 1440×900 and 390×844 with screenshots, waiting at least 800ms after state changes.
3. Test founding a second city, tile claiming, research modal, help modal, ruins/villages, and city capture through UI interactions.
4. Balance AI aggression/production if necessary so a reasonable player strategy can survive or win by turn 20.
5. Run final screenshot capture and confirm no page errors or visual regressions.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: page structure, SVG icon sprite, script includes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: all layout, map, tokens, panels, modals, responsive styles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: map, terrain, units, buildings, techs, factions, constants.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/state.js`: state creation, yields, paths, scoring, helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/render.js`: board rendering, tokens, panels, modals, tooltips, end screen.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/actions.js`: selection, movement, economy, research, combat, end-turn flow.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ai.js`: AI production, targeting, movement, improvements.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/app.js`: boot, events, keyboard shortcuts.
- `/tmp/pocket-desktop.png`: initial desktop screenshot.
- `/tmp/pocket-turn3.png`: mid-game screenshots, showing visual issues.
- `/tmp/pocket-end.png`: defeat/end screenshot.
- `/tmp/test-play.mjs`: interaction test script.
- `/tmp/test-defense.mjs`: defensive 20-turn simulation.
- `/tmp/test-long.mjs`: passive 20-turn simulation.
- `/tmp/test-ai.mjs`: AI state inspection test.

## Important Context
- Server is running in tmux session `pocket` on port `3002` via `PORT=3002 RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime ./start.sh`.
- `playwright-cli` fails because it expects Chromium `chromium-1243`; system Chrome works with Playwright `executablePath: '/opt/google/chrome/chrome'`.
- The game deliberately has no package.json and is served as static HTML by `default-start.mjs`.
- Combat formula now: unit damage `clamp(5 + round((atk-def)/2), 3, 9)`; city damage `clamp(4 + round((atk-def)/2), 2, 9)`.
- Current AI holds until turn 6 (`state.turn >= 6 || aiIsThreatened()`).
- Current defensive test output: reached turn 20, ended by time, player capital at 20 HP, AI Cinderhold at 30 HP, 8 AI units alive.
- Changes are uncommitted in the working tree.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished, playable 2D Civilization-style browser game on a tiny 10×10 map limited to 20 turns, from the user request: "2D Civilization on a tiny 10×10 map, 20 turns".

## Requirements
- 2D civilization game.
- 10×10 map.
- Exactly 20 turns.
- Playable in a browser with polished visuals.
- Responsive/mobile-friendly presentation.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/JS with no build system or external dependencies.
- Theme: “Pocket Empire — Tiny World · Twenty Turns,” dark cartographic war-room aesthetic with parchment/gold/jade accents.
- Player faction “Sunfall Reach” versus AI “Cinder Court.”
- Gameplay: city production, growth, territory claiming, workers/improvements, research, ruins/villages, combat, city capture, and end-of-game Legacy scoring.
- Handcrafted 10×10 map with two capitals, terrain types, ruins, and villages.
- AI aggression starts on turn 9 or when the player approaches within 3 tiles of Cinderhold.
- AI army capped at 4 units.
- Player capital starts with unique `palace` building (“Palace of Dawn”) giving +1 production, +1 science, +4 building legacy, plus player `legacyBonus: 4`.
- Fortify bonus increased to +4; walls city-defence bonus increased to +3; fortified units heal +4/turn.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built complete game structure in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and JS modules under `js/`.
- Implemented 10×10 map, 20-turn loop, cities, units, settlers, workers, improvements, research, combat, AI, score, toasts, tooltips, help/research modals, sound, and end screen.
- Added left-panel legacy stat grid (`People`, `Land`, `Lore`, `Works`, `Host`) and a pinned chronicle footer.
- Added right-panel persistent “Field Notes / Advisor’s counsel” card pinned below a scrollable context area.
- Redesigned unit icons as bold filled silhouettes: crossed swords for warrior, compass arrow for scout, wagon for settler, pickaxe for worker, filled shield for spearman.
- Fixed unit-on-city stacking with offset/scale styling and garrison-aware city name plates.
- Enlarged city name plates and added city glow/city-tile emphasis.
- Added stronger map grid separation via `.board::after`.
- Moved toast layer to bottom-right on desktop and full-width bottom on mobile.
- Added city header text showing “Palace of Dawn” when present.
- Verified desktop and mobile screenshots with no console/page errors.
- Verified research modal, help modal, turn cycling, unit stacking, and conquest end screen through Playwright.
- Balanced gameplay: passive play loses 96 vs 105 on time; a competent active playthrough wins 114 vs 105.

### Active
- Final visual/UX verification after the latest palace-header and balance changes.
- Need to confirm no regressions at 1440×900 and 390×844 after final edits.
- Need to test founding a second city, tile claiming, ruins/villages, and city capture through actual UI interactions (not direct state manipulation).

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Re-run desktop and mobile screenshots, waiting at least 800ms after state changes, and inspect palace header and field-notes layout.
2. Test founding a second city, tile claiming, ruins/villages, and city capture via UI clicks.
3. Check the passive and active balance simulations once more after the palace header edit.
4. Remove or update stale placeholder values in `index.html` if needed.
5. Final pass for console errors and responsive regressions, then commit changes.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: page structure, SVG icon sprite, left/right panel markup, script includes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: layout, map grid, city/unit tokens, advisor card, modals, responsive styles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: map, terrain, units, buildings including `palace`, techs, factions, constants.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/state.js`: state creation, palace starting building/bonus, yields, paths, scoring, helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/render.js`: board rendering, stacked tokens, panels, advisor, modals, tooltips, end screen.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/actions.js`: selection, movement, economy, research, combat, end-turn flow, AI army cap.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ai.js`: AI production, targeting, movement, aggression timing, improvements.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/app.js`: boot, events, keyboard shortcuts.
- `/tmp/pocket-desktop.png`: latest desktop screenshot.
- `/tmp/pocket-mobile.png`: latest mobile screenshot.
- `/tmp/test-polish.mjs`: tests stacking, research/help modals, turn cycling, and conquest.
- `/tmp/test-smart.mjs`: competent-play balance simulation.
- `/tmp/test-long.mjs`: passive-play balance simulation.

## Important Context
- Server runs in tmux session `pocket` on port 3002 via `PORT=3002 RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime ./start.sh`.
- Playwright uses system Chrome at `/opt/google/chrome/chrome` because the installed browser version mismatched.
- Test scripts create Playwright via `createRequire('/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/package.json')`.
- Game deliberately has no `package.json` and is served as static HTML.
- Current combat: unit damage `clamp(5 + round((atk-def)/2), 3, 9)`; city damage `clamp(4 + round((atk-def)/2), 2, 9)`.
- Current AI: production priority economy-first, army cap 4, aggression at `state.turn >= 9 || aiIsThreatened()`.
- `cityDefence` base 6, walls +4, bronze +1; `cityDefenceBonus` walls +3.
- All changes remain uncommitted in the working tree.
